name: ChocoMania
about: ChocoMania by Teena Khandelwal, Durg (Chhattisgarh): curated gourmet gifting, handcrafted EGGLESS cakes and chocolates for weddings, corporate gifting and celebrations; hands-on baking workshops (e.g. tiramisu tres leches) in small groups. FSSAI registered. Orders by Instagram DM.
audience: Families, brides-to-be, wedding planners and companies in Durg, Bhilai and Raipur who want a special, eggless, handmade cake or gift box; people who would love to learn baking in a workshop
rules: Use ONLY facts from 'about': eggless, handcrafted, gifting for weddings / corporate / celebrations, workshops, FSSAI registered, Durg. Never invent anything else.
Never state a price, discount, offer, delivery time, delivery area beyond Durg-Bhilai-Raipur, workshop date or seat count: those come from the owner only.
Never claim awards, customer counts, 'best in city', 'No. 1', health or sugar-free claims.
Never name or compare with other bakeries or brands.
Every scene shows her real product or kitchen from the library; never describe something the picture does not show.
The tone is warm, elegant and personal (a home chocolatier), never shouty sales talk.

voice.style: warm, elegant Indian woman (a home chocolatier) talking softly to a friend about her craft, natural Indian English, calm reel pace with small pauses

cta: a short spoken line inviting viewers to DM ChocoMania to order or ask about the next workshop (no price, no date), e.g. 'Planning a celebration? Just DM us.'
